{{Top|leg}}
'''Credit tokens''' were a form of [[Currency/Legends|currency]] used on backwater [[Planet/Legends|planets]]<ref name="GG2">''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]''</ref> that could be made of [[Plastic/Legends|plastic]].<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref> The tokens could be replicated by [[Forger (profession)/Legends|forgers]] using various metals and [[plastisynth]]s but it was not usually worth the time or effort when more profitable forms of forgery were available.<ref name="GG2" />
